visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a top-down view of a light wooden table surface. An orange Hermes box, a closed brown leather wallet, and a white fabric pouch are arranged neatly. Warm, bright natural light casts a soft shadow from the left. Traditional Chinese text overlays appear in the center. (2) Close-up focus on a pair of female hands with manicured grey nails and silver rings. The hands hold a fan of colorful New Year banknotes including green, brown, blue, and purple denominations, alongside a striking gold-etched foil sheet. (3) The hands interact with a bright red paper envelope on the table. The person displays individual banknotes one by one to the camera against the wooden background, followed by a sequence where the gold foil 'money mother' is highlighted. (4) The hands meticulously stack the various colored banknotes and slide them into a red envelope featuring a textured golden snake design. The background remains the consistent indoor wooden tabletop environment. (5) The hands untie a dark brown decorative ribbon from the orange Hermes box and lift the lid. A brand new, grey-brown leather wallet (Hermes Bearn) is revealed resting inside white protective paper. (6) A series of fast-paced cuts shows the hands transferring items—various bank cards, ID cards, a collection of coins, and a yellow fabric amulet—from the old white pouch into the slots and zippered compartment of the new brown wallet. (7) The finished, organized brown wallet is held up toward the camera. The main character gives a 'thumbs up' gesture with one hand while holding the wallet, signifying the completion of the New Year wealth-attraction ritual.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM in a major key. The music is continuous and establishes a cheerful mood. (2) A crisp paper rustling sound occurs as the banknotes are manipulated, followed by a soft thud. (3) A distinct 'crinkle' and 'pop' sound signifies the handling of the red envelope and paper bills being inserted. (4) A smooth, sliding friction sound of the box lid being removed and ribbon being pulled is clearly audible. (5) Frequent high-frequency 'click' and 'snap' sounds represent the wallet's clasp opening and closing. (6) Rhythmic 'swish' sounds occur as plastic cards are inserted into leather slots in rapid succession. (7) Clear metallic clinking sounds are heard as several coins are dropped into a compartment. (8) A short, sharp 'zip' sound of a zipper being closed. (9) The audio concludes with the BGM and a final high-pitched shimmer/ding SFX coinciding with the creator's thumbs-up.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a ritualistic tutorial for 'attracting wealth' during the New Year by meticulously organizing a brand new high-end Hermes wallet. It uses the concept of the 'Five Elements' (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water) by selecting specific colored banknotes to create a 'portable wealth treasury.' The intent is to showcase a luxury product while sharing cultural or personal lifestyle tips for good fortune.
